members.name: disabled
members.doc: Marks the group disabled. It does not disable the controls inside it.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the group invalid. It does not mark the controls inside it.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Marks the group read-only with a data attribute on its root. It does not lock the controls inside it.

members.name: role
members.doc: The role of the group's root. Use presentation when the Group only lays controls out and needs no name.
